answers.core: With an implemented proposal like #1316 this would be an option for an extension. However, this is something every developer will come across in their projects, I do feel this would be a worthwhile addition to core.
answers.workaround: Without a proposal like #1316, I don't see a possible elegant solution. It is as of yet possible to achieve the same _functionality_, but this proposal would implement a simpler _syntax_. This is equivalent to what the documentation on `@onready` states: `It can replace (...) code with a single line`.
